entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit customer support. Your call is important to us. Please wait while we connect you with an agent.
Thank you for calling VeloFit! My name is Alex. How can I help you today?
Hi Alex, I recently received a VeloFit bike I ordered online, and unfortunately, it's damaged.
Oh, I'm so sorry to hear that! Can you describe the damage you're seeing?
Yes, the bike arrived a few days ago, and I noticed the frame has a cracked frame in two places. Also, one of the wheels is incredibly wobbly wheel. It seems like shipping damage.

I understand. That sounds very frustrating. We sincerely apologize for the inconvenience and any shipping damage caused during transit. To resolve this for you immediately, we're happy to offer a full refund for the bike.
Absolutely. And we'll also provide a free label for you to return the damaged bike. You won't have to pay anything for the return shipping. Would that work for you?
That sounds perfect! Thank you so much!

You're very welcome! I've already processed the refund, and you should see it reflected in your account within 5-7 business days. I've also emailed you the free label for the return. Just pack the bike back in its original box, affix the label, and drop it off at any authorized carrier location. The email will contain all instructions.
We aim to please! Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that's everything. Thank you again for your quick and easy resolution!
You're very welcome! Thank you for being a VeloFit customer. Have a wonderful day!
